title: Revert glassmorphism theme to previous version

requirements.summary: Revert all glassmorphism theme changes applied in version 14 across all frontend files, restoring the UI to its prior state before the glassmorphism theme was applied site-wide
acceptanceCriteria: All frontend files that were modified to apply the glassmorphism theme are restored to their pre-glassmorphism state.
The site visually matches the version prior to the glassmorphism update.
No glassmorphism-specific utility classes or styles introduced in the latest update remain active across components.
All pages (Home, Annual Program, Our Legacy) render correctly without glassmorphism overrides from the reverted changes.

file_operations.description: Remove glassmorphism-specific CSS custom properties and utility classes introduced in version 14. Restore the pre-glassmorphism global stylesheet with original color tokens and base styles, removing glass-card, glass-border, glass-glow, and related glassmorphism utilities.

Remove glassmorphism theme extensions added in version 14 including glass color tokens, backdrop blur scales, and glassmorphism-specific box shadows. Restore the previous Tailwind configuration with original theme settings.
Remove glassmorphism background styling and glass effects from the footer component. Restore the previous footer design with original background treatment and styling that existed before version 14.
Remove glassmorphism styling from hero stat cards and any glass effects applied to the hero section. Restore the previous hero section design with original card styling.
Remove glass-styled card treatments from the three risk cards. Restore the previous card styling without glassmorphism effects.
Remove glassmorphism effects from the Trade Trust Score section. Restore the previous styling for the progress bars and radar chart visualization area.
Remove glassmorphism styling from deliverable cards. Restore the previous card design for the eight deliverable items.
Remove glassmorphism effects from the four-step process cards. Restore the previous card styling for the Submit, Research, Score, and Report steps.
Remove glassmorphism styling from pricing plan cards. Restore the previous design for Single Report and Annual Program cards.
Remove glassmorphism effects from stats metric cards. Restore the previous styling for the three key metrics display.
Remove glassmorphism card styling from the final call-to-action section. Restore the previous CTA card design.
Remove glassmorphism styling from annual program pricing cards. Restore the previous design for the pricing section.
Remove any glassmorphism effects applied to the FAQ accordion section. Restore the previous accordion styling.
Remove glassmorphism styling from core pillars cards and any glass effects on the legacy page. Restore the previous design for Independence, Transparency, Global Reach, and Precision sections.
